title: Open Itinerary
description: An agent-optimized, app-consumable format for travel itineraries and road trips.

$schema.description: Must point to the Open Itinerary schema URI.

version.description: Schema version this document conforms to.

title.description: Short human-readable name for the itinerary.

summary.description: A one-to-three sentence overview of the itinerary, suitable for display as a description or agent handoff context.

tags.description: Free-form labels for filtering and discovery.

duration_days.description: Suggested total trip length in days. Informational; does not constrain stop count.

travel_modes.description: All travel modes used across this itinerary.

stops.description: Ordered list of stops. Sequence implies suggested visit order, not a strict schedule.

generated_by.description: Optional. Name or identifier of the agent or app that produced this itinerary.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this itinerary was generated.

Location.description: A named place. `name` (and optionally `address`) is the source of truth. `coords` is a derived cache populated by the geocoder — never set by hand, never trusted over the name.

name.description: Display name of the location. This is the authoritative identifier — what a human would search for.

address.description: Optional street address or locality. Used as a geocoding hint when present.

place_id.description: Optional external place identifier. Prefix with source namespace: 'gplaces:ChIJ...' or 'osm:node/12345'.

Coords.description: Geocoded coordinates. Always produced by a geocoder, never authored by hand or by an AI agent. Treat as a cache: discard and re-geocode if `name` or `address` changes.

source.description: Geocoding provider that produced these coordinates.

geocoded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when geocoding was performed. Useful for cache invalidation.

Duration.description: A suggested time range to spend at a stop. Both fields are optional; omit if truly unknown.

min_hours.description: Minimum suggested hours at this stop.

max_hours.description: Maximum suggested hours at this stop.

note.description: Free-text clarification, e.g. 'allow longer if hiking'.
examples: allow longer if you plan to hike

Stop.description: A single point of interest or waypoint in the itinerary.

id.description: Unique identifier for this stop within the itinerary. Stable across edits; used for references.

goal.description: Short phrase describing the purpose or intent of this stop. The 'why' behind visiting.
examples: Grab lunch at a seafood shack
Scenic viewpoint — stretch and take photos

category.description: Broad category for filtering and iconography.

notes.description: Additional context, tips, or caveats for this stop. Markdown is supported.

day.description: Optional suggested day number (1-indexed). Use when grouping stops by day matters but exact times do not.

alternatives.description: Other options the traveler could choose instead of or in addition to this stop (e.g. nearby restaurants, alternate hotels).

Alternative.description: A suggested alternative or supplement to a stop. Lighter than a full Stop — no id or nested alternatives.
